snippet.title: Star Trucker | Business Ventures #2 | Plants & Post
snippet.description:
We’re celebrating 2 incredible years of Star Trucker with a new update: Business Ventures #2: Plants & Post. 

Specialist Courier is a FREE unlock and introduces a range of jobs themed around mail alongside a range of fantastic new customization rewards.

Cultivation Expert is a PREMIUM venture that can be unlocked as part of the new DLC, Cultivation Content Pack. This unlocks a new set of jobs, rewards PLUS unique new trailers and cargo to haul.

Keep truckin'! https://star-trucker.com/
